## Book II — Article XXII
## AI Absorption Principle™ (AAP™)
AAP™ (TI-038): Organizational Absorption™ is the mechanism through which intelligence becomes enterprise value. Adoption measures participation. Absorption measures transformation.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-038

AAS™ (TI-039): AI Absorption Score™ measures demonstrated capacity to operationalize intelligence — leading indicator of Transformation Capacity™.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-039

https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-038
https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-039

## Book IV — Transformation Absorbability™
TAP™ (TI-040): As intelligence becomes abundant, absorbability becomes the limiting factor of enterprise transformation.
Intelligence Conversion Continuum™: Observation → Information → Knowledge → Understanding → Acceptance → Commitment → Execution → Habit → Organizational Capability → Enterprise Value.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-040

IPP™ (TI-041): Identity Preservation Principle™ — organizations reject intelligence because it threatens identity, not because it is incorrect.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-041

TFP™ (TI-042): Transformation Friction Principle™ — friction must be measured, not assumed. Eight friction sources including structural, political, emotional, and historical.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-042

TAS™ (TI-043): Transformation Absorbability Score™ — the primary predictor of whether opportunity becomes realized value.
Canonical: https://lensanalysis.com/constitution/ti-043
